scheme_name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching To Scheduled Tribe Student Studying In Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.

Student must be a regular, full-time student studying in a government school, higher secondary school, or a school recognized by the Government of Goa or a Central/State Board of Higher Secondary Education.
Reimbursement is not provided for a second year if the student repeats a class due to failure.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 75% of coaching fees (up to ₹10,000 per subject per year in rural areas and ₹12,000 in urban areas) paid directly to the institute via DBT.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Fee receipt certified by the competent authority of the coaching institute
Fee structure certified by the competent authority of the coaching institute
Attendance Certificate of the First Term (required for second instalment)
application_link: Step 1: Visit the Office of the Director/ Deputy Director, Department of Tribal Welfare, Govt. of Goa, and request a physical copy of the proforma of the application form for the scheme from the Concerned Authority. OR Take a print of the format of the Application Form. Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, affix the passport-sized photograph (signed across), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Concerned Authority. Step 4: Acquire the receipt/acknowledgement of the successful submission of the application from the Department's Office.
